tenures.source: the fed's own Friday Night Raw broadcast, 20 February 1998; the fed's own Ring Masters broadcast, 22 March 1998; the fed's own King of the Mats pay-per-view, 24 May 1998; the fed's own Supremer Awards, 20 June 1998; the fed's own Warzone pay-per-view, 21 June 1998; the fed's own Monday Madness, 29 June 1998
tenures.notes: Debuted under the name Biggy, brought to the ring by a manager called The Kid, and won a three-way with Dead Alien and Dark Knight by eliminating both. Announced the ring name Kraze mid-show at Ring Masters (22 March 1998) and used it for the rest of this record; billed holding the SWL United States Television Title entering that show. Challenged Anthony Mislan for the SWL World Heavyweight Title at King of the Mats (24 May 1998), winning by referee stoppage after Mislan's leg was injured, though the title did not change hands on the stoppage. Billed the promotion's own Supremer Strap Champion by 20 June 1998 and tied Insanity for the Wrestler of the Year award that night; retained the Supremer Strap against Anthony Mislan at Warzone after an unlicensed referee's fast count was overturned and the restarted match ended in a disqualification, then survived a chair-shot ambush from Insanity on Monday Madness still carrying the belt.

identity.note: Two unrelated wings already hold a wrestler of this exact ring name (one held under the bare id "kraze"); no shared operator, host or roster evidence ties any of them.
